rationale_summary: The CP criterion is broad and does not explicitly require cumulative satisfaction of separate property and establishment controls or of each detailed condition. The grounded norms are parallel expressions for different facility types and operational details that collectively support the single effectiveness requirement. Therefore, SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION is the appropriate relation for all groupings, avoiding over-atomization.
